fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics analyst target prices range from KRW 270,000 to KRW 670,000, a 2.5x spread, with valuations diverging at current price levels of KRW 200,000 depending on the speed of AI memory entry.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 operating profit reached KRW 107 trillion with an operating margin of 55%, marking a record, but conservative analysts are lowering target prices due to differing views on memory supply-demand outlook.
fields.summary_ko.2: HBM4 yield improvement, share buyback capacity, and memory price trends are identified as three key variables determining second-half stock performance.
